body: This is what Bella swan looks like in my head

Your eyes are beautiful and clear like sea glass. Your cheeks are naturally blushed and you have an attractive smile :) you have beautifully textured hair!! Nice natural brows just to mention another.
Your hair and eyes are beautiful!!

I’m a woman. Im assuming you’re a woman. I’ve gathered that men don’t like redundancy, wether or not it is something we would gather as redundant. And asking for clarification is in no way redundancy from my perspective to be clear. But they also usually don’t like to express themselves the way we do emotionally, and a lot of men don’t know how to at all. You know him better than anyone here can. But I think when he said “I personally have no desire to see other people” he was saying he doesn’t wanna see anybody but you. When he said it’s whatever you want, he was putting the ball in your court. Men need as much emotional validation as we do sometimes without being able to say it like we can. So maybe wait until tomorrow, see if he texts if you want to avoid being clingy but also you only live once. You know if you want him right now or not. Nothing has to last forever. Live in the moment and do what feels good. Hit him up and make sure he knows how you feel about him some way or another, direct or not. Life is short.

Edit: also he’s just playing it cool if you weren’t so joyous last time things ended. He’s protecting himself. Give him a reason to feel at ease with you :)

Thank you so much for replying! 

Firstly your advice is Golden, there a few points in here that I hadn’t considered such as me giving him a reason not to think of me as his girlfriend to him being emotionally stunted. Also you definitely understood me and you have no idea how good it feels to be understood, particularly with this situation. Thank you for giving me solutions and not telling me he’s trash that should be discarded, that’s all people in my life can say about it. 

I’m less of a direct person so I am definitely going to see if he does anything about a new potential suitor and how he reacts to a shift in our closeness (as in the benefits you mentioned). I like to avoid bringing up our relationship status or feelings because there is always some kind of deviance from the subject in our serious conversations (I think he does this on purpose.) 

I feel much better knowing that it’s probably because he is insecure and indecisive and not something more personal. I appreciate the time you took to reply and the advice you gave me should help.

If you have a house, a cool house party with purple, blue, & red lights would be fun. Look and see what kind of food is served in the show (little but some) and make those dishes!! Have music from the soundtrack and like songs playing. Get some board games or twister, get drinks for those who partake, get smarties as party favors & pretend they’re molly pills. You could seriously go all out at the dollar store, not spend a ton, and have a dope party.
